To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) 1/3 of the GLR organisations offer special services for the older members with RMDs, 2) the services include exercises adapted age related limitations, patient education and social activities, and 3) 20% of the members are not able to use the desired services because of health or other reasons.
1. The services provided by PARE organisations are adapted to the special needs of older individuals.
The majority of PARE institutions offer services to elderly people, but the services are mainly directed towards the prevention of falls.
